bullets.text: ChatGPT's Year-End Review - **OpenAI** introduces a personalized recap feature akin to **Spotify Wrapped** for users in select markets.
Apple's 2025 Highlights - A recap of significant events including **Siri** delays and the launch of the **iPhone 17** series.
iOS 26 Reminders Upgrade - New time zone support enhances the **Reminders** app for travelers during the busy holiday season.
ServiceNow Acquires Armis - **ServiceNow** agrees to acquire cybersecurity startup **Armis** for $7.75 billion, boosting its security portfolio.
Aflac Data Breach - **Aflac** confirms hackers stole personal data of 22.6 million individuals in a significant cyberattack.
Amazon's Alexa+ Expands - **Amazon** enhances **Alexa+** with new integrations for booking services, improving user convenience.
Digital Avatar Tech Funding - **Lemon Slice** secures $10.5 million to develop interactive digital avatars for enhanced user engagement.
Tooth Fairy Tracker Launch - A new interactive **Tooth Fairy Tracker** app engages children with personalized updates on their lost teeth.
